limitations: No scene-wide texture/material residency or native scene-index dispatch integration.
Flat input reconstruction, validation buffers and per-request allocations remain.
Resident tables are duplicated per flight to avoid cross-stream readers/writers.
Versioned descriptors add bytes; fewer repeated record uploads do not guarantee faster rendering.
No multiworker, arbitrary-material, adaptive or production-scene qualification.
